requirements.normative_requirement: Guest kernel, initramfs, immutable rootfs, boundary-init, boundary-agent, adapter, daemon, compiler, canonicalization, backend, and protocol are pinned in one immutable TCB generation.
requirements.threat_or_failure: Supply-chain drift and unreviewed runtime change
requirements.primary_verification: Attestation mismatch test for each component digest.

requirements.normative_requirement: The image bundle includes an SBOM and reproducible provenance tied to the released package.
requirements.primary_verification: SBOM/provenance schema validation and digest linkage in release evidence.

requirements.normative_requirement: QEMU runs unprivileged with seccomp sandboxing, no NIC, and no GPU, USB, audio, clipboard, host filesystem, or arbitrary device passthrough.
requirements.primary_verification: Effective QEMU argv and device-tree attestation plus negative device/network canaries.
